references.text: The Levites were chosen to serve in the sanctuary and assist the priests, which Micah believed would bring him blessing.
A Levite acting as a priest pronounces a blessing and assurance of the Lord's favor, just as Micah expected.
Jacob believed that Laban was blessed because of him, in the same way that Micah thought a Levitical priest would bring the Lord's blessing.
The same Levite whom Micah hired continues his service and gives a blessing to the spies from the tribe of Dan.
The Levite leaves Micah to become a priest for an entire tribe, showing that his service was tied to personal gain rather than true worship.
Jesus warns against those who say 'Lord, Lord' but do not do God's will, in contrast to Micah's superstition that a Levitical priest would automatically secure God's favor.
